scope: Native US message-window rendering, text insertion, and raw style-table mapping reviewed from Ghidra .main decompilation/disassembly.
confidence: Verified structural behavior and scalar offsets from Ghidra; scene-specific style selection remains unverified.

func_8000B8B0_C4B0.finding: Main message-window renderer visits all three slots and renders each non-null window independently of scenario-interpreter dispatch.

func_8000C260_CE60.finding: Allocates/configures a message window in the selected idle slot.

func_8000C878_D478.finding: Releases the window allocation in the selected slot.

func_8000D060_DC60.finding: Inserts one glyph into the first free of 120 records and advances horizontal cursor +0x6E by glyph width plus one. US printable ASCII maps by subtracting 0x20.

renderer.finding: The renderer reads the low nibble of the per-glyph field at +0x06 for the G_SETTILE palette selector. Other bits in the field control glyph display effects and should be preserved.

relatedNativeColorIds.finding: Native text color IDs 4 and 5 map to the same palette ranges. The specific file-select scene call path was not traced; no claim is made that it invokes these IDs.

func_8000C3EC_CFEC.finding: Resets horizontal cursor and advances the current line position by the native line step.

func_8000C454_D054.finding: Enables blink effect state for subsequently inserted glyph records.

func_8000C488_D088.finding: Clears blink effect state for subsequently inserted glyph records.

func_8000D180_DD80.finding: Per-glyph insertion/render helper applies text insets +0x50/+0x54 and adjusts center coordinates.
func_8000D180_DD80.uncertainty: Full direct-call signature and behavior of scale values greater than one were not established; no public prototype or scale-range claim added.

styleTable.unknown: The style-specific scene caller for the Sun God dialogue example was not traced. Its lack of a visible panel is consistent with styles 10 and 11 having panel primitive alpha 0, but the evidence does not identify which style index it selects.

style10.recordFields: All nine 32-bit fields are byte-for-byte identical to style 11.

style11.recordFields: All nine 32-bit fields are byte-for-byte identical to style 10.

limits: A standalone native window draw does not itself create a scenario VM or acquire a control lock; this is not a guarantee about other systems or conflicts on an occupied slot.
No scale values above 1.0 were documented because D180 direct-call ABI and scale semantics remain uncertain.
Styles 10 and 11 are identical in the inspected table, and no scene-specific allocator call identifies which index is used for the Sun God dialogue example.
The file-select scene call path was not traced. Native color IDs 4 and 5 were observed to map to the same palette ranges, but their use by that scene is unconfirmed.

modSourceSnapshot.note: Internal source snapshot only; not evidence of the native scene-specific style choice.
